definitions.explanation: One complete revolution around a track, course, or celestial body. Also used as a counter for laps.
The act of traveling around a place or area, making a full circuit.

notes:
A compound of {周|しゅう} (around) and ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (turn, revolve).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周回|しゅうかい}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ (circuit course, lap course)
- {周回|しゅうかい}レース (circuit race)
- {周回|しゅうかい}⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧ (being a lap behind)
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{周回|しゅうかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to orbit the Earth)
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{周回|しゅうかい} (final lap)

In motorsport and running, {周回|しゅうかい}⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧ is also used figuratively to mean being far behind others in terms of knowledge, technology, or trends.
